title: Make protocol adoption and idea capture reliable
description: Agents adopting the protocol need supported installations to validate, every distinct project idea to be retained without duplicates, and clear completion semantics. Implement approved recommendations 1-3 and 5: separate strict distribution checks from adopted-project checks; optional Claude pointer; existing contract links and project additions allowed in adoption; search all existing Beads before creation; append dated user quotations on repeated interest and update canonical details; ask owner about conflicts; distinguish capture from authorization; clarify closure and existing-tracker protection; provide on-demand new-project-setup with installation, reuse, sync, recovery and fresh-session verification. Weekly review and two-project field trials have separate work records.
acceptance_criteria: Supported one-file and customized installations pass; missing or invalid pointers and broken links fail; strict shared package retains size and dependency gates. Concise core stays below 6000 characters. Setup procedure covers new and existing projects and relevant failures without duplicating command ownership. Relevant tests, documentation links and diff checks pass. Commit and push task files and sync Beads. Field effectiveness is not claimed.
notes:
2026-09-14 owner approval: "Approve all". Capture amendment: "existing Beads must be searched for matches. They should be updated if a match, with a note of the recurrence of interest (dated mention with a quotation from user) and updating the Bead itself if there is any new information or detail. If conflicts are found, ask user." Acceptance is authorization of scope, not acceptance of the resulting artifact.
Implementation complete pending delivery: AGENTS capture searches existing and closed records, records dated owner quotations, updates new details, and asks on conflicts; closure and existing-tracker ownership clarified.
